title: receipt at timestamp from untrusted peer clock has no sanity clamp
description: In ReceiptHandler, the peer-supplied at field is stored as delivered_at/read_at after RFC 3339 validation only. CLAUDE.md trust table marks peer timestamps as untrusted. A malicious peer can set at to year 9999, causing misleading UI (message shown as read before it was sent, or far in the future). Recommended: clamp at_unix to [0, now_unix + grace] before storing.
